title: WebStoreMessageContent - Data API
description: Represents the assocation of a managed content message record in CMS to a web store, along with other attributes that specify the application and intent of the message content. This object is available in API version 61.0 and later.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsActive.description: Indicates whether this message content is active (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

ManagedContentId.description: The ID of the managed content in CMS. This field is a relationship field.

MessageApp.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
MessageApp.description: The application type that uses the message content. Possible values are: Email

MessageUsage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
MessageUsage.description: The usage type of the message content. Possible values are: AbandonedCart OrderConfirmation

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The autogenerated name of the message content.

WebStoreId.description: The ID of the web store. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules:
